name: Magnum Truck Racks
old_description: If you see a 2025 or 2026 vehicle option, fitment is confirmed. If not, we are still working on confirming fitment.
about:
Magnum Truck Racks operates from Waterville, Maine, as a brand of the Aebi Schmidt Group. The company focuses on truck headache racks and accessories for pickup and service body trucks.

The product line spans headache racks in five model families—Low Pro, High Pro, Standard, Sport, and Service Body—along with bed rails, ladder racks, toolboxes, rear racks, wiring harnesses, and mounting accessories. All racks are built from aluminum and finished in matte black, mill finish, or satin white. The proprietary Glide Track system allows adjustable mounting without drilling. LED lighting packages integrate brake, backup, tail, and turn signals. Fitments cover model years from 2000 through 2026 for Chevrolet, Dodge, Ford, Jeep, GMC, Nissan, Ram, and Toyota trucks.

Customers include individual truck owners, commercial fleets, and upfitters who service body trucks. A dealer network extends across the U.S., and the company offers a 10 percent discount to military, police, and fire personnel. Orders over $100 ship free.

Magnum emphasizes lightweight strength, corrosion resistance, and installation flexibility as its core differentiators. The Glide Track system and vehicle-specific engineering aim to reduce install time and ensure a secure fit for each application.
